name: Alexander Shchebelskyy
hero_subtitle: Full-stack developer focused on web applications, mobile apps, SaaS products, and specialized software from concept to deployment.

1.header: I build software from idea to reality
1.body1: I'm a software developer focused on building thoughtful, reliable applications for startups and businesses.
1.body2: My work spans full-stack web applications, mobile apps, SaaS products, and specialized software. I enjoy taking an idea and turning it into something people can actually use.
1.body3: I focus on clean interfaces and maintainable architecture, rather than simply implementing a list of features.

2.fullstack_development_text: Web applications, APIs, authentication, dashboards, and SaaS platforms.
2.mobile_development_text: Cross-platform applications for iOS and Android using React Native and Expo.
2.custom_software_text: Interactive tools, visualization software, and specialized software.
2.mvp_development_text: Helping turn an early-stage idea into a functional product.

3.body1: I prefer to work closely with the problem before jumping into the implementation. Once the requirements are clear, I build incrementally, communicate throughout the process, and keep the codebase structured.
3.body2: Whether you need an MVP, a customer-facing application, or a custom internal tool, my goal is the same: build software that is useful, understandable, and built to last.

0.title: Langua
0.subtitle: Language Tutoring Platform
0.body: A full-stack platform designed to connect language learners with structured educational content and instructors. I designed and developed the application architecture, user experience, authentication, database layer, and dynamic course system.

1.title: Vector E-Lab
1.subtitle: Interactive Chemistry Tool
1.body: An interactive chemistry application for constructing and visualizing molecular structures. The project required custom graphical logic for molecular representation, atom positioning, structural formulas, and switching between different visualization modes.

2.title: MIO Connect
2.subtitle: Prosthetic Configuration Software
2.body: A desktop application for configuring and communicating with experimental myoelectric prosthetic hardware. The project combines software development with embedded hardware, including serial communication, microcontrollers, EMG input, motor control, and a desktop configuration interface.

3.title: Peak Fitness
3.subtitle: Community Fitness Application
3.body: A mobile application concept centered around community-driven fitness, activity tracking, and social interaction. The project explores mobile-first product design, authentication, user profiles, and community features.
